tutAskMega: This is Mega mode: some numbers span two lines. Want to see how it’s played?
tutAskColor: This is Colour mode: every block has a colour. Want to see how it’s played?
tutC1: In colour nonograms every number has the colour of its block. The palette above the board shows the colours of this puzzle and how many cells of each are still missing.
tutC2: The second row is one red block of 5. Pick red in the palette and fill the row.
tutC3: Blocks of different colours may touch without a gap: the middle column says red 2, then green 2, right below each other. Fill the middle column – red first, then switch to green.
tutC4: Two blocks of the same colour still need a gap between them. Now finish the picture.
tutCEnd: Lovely! That’s Colour mode. Puzzles from games with colour puzzles are marked 🎨, MomoGram’s colour versions of a game’s pictures ✨.
colorFromGameHelp: This is one of the game’s own colour puzzles.
colorByMomoHelp: Made by MomoGram from the colour picture of the game; its solutions were checked.
colorHelp: Colour mode: puzzles where every block has a colour. Blocks of the same colour need a gap between them, blocks of different colours may touch. Pick a colour below the board.
noColor: None of your games has colour puzzles yet.
tagline: All your nonograms in one place. Careful, it eats time.
noGameData: MomoGram ships without any game data. Everything it reads from your games stays on this device.
dailyHelp: 15 fresh puzzles every day, 5 per difficulty
randomHelp: A random puzzle from your library
tutAsk: New to nonograms (or to MomoGram)? A short tutorial shows how it works.
tut1: A nonogram hides a picture. The numbers next to each row and above each column tell you how many cells in that line are filled, block by block. Let’s solve this one together.
tut2: The top row says 5, and it has five cells: all of them are filled. Draw along the row with your finger (or the mouse) to fill it.
tut3: The third row and the middle column also say 5. Fill both of them.
tut4: Several numbers are separate blocks with at least one empty cell between them. “1 1 1” in five cells fits only one way: filled, gap, filled, gap, filled. The middle one is already there – add the other two.
tut5: The bottom row says 1, and that cell is already filled. The rest must stay empty: mark them with ✕. Tap the tool button at the bottom left to switch to ✕, then cross out the four other cells.
tut6: Numbers turn grey when their block is certainly done. Now finish the picture on your own – look for lines where only one placement fits. Tap the tool button to switch back to filling.
tutEnd: Solved! That’s all you need. On Easy, mistakes are caught for you; Normal and Hard leave more to you and earn better medals.
tutM1: In Mega mode some numbers belong to two rows (or two columns) at once. A Mega number, in a frame across both lines, counts one connected shape that reaches into both of them.
tutM2: Rows 2 and 3 are a pair. The framed 2 is one shape in both rows; the small numbers are ordinary blocks that stay in one row (the upper number for the upper row, the lower one for the lower row).
tutM3: Try it: fill the left cell of rows 2 and 3 – that’s the Mega 2, one cell in each row, connected.
tutM4: Now finish the picture. Mega shapes can bend, but their cells always touch each other.
tutMEnd: Well done – that’s Mega! Switch to Mega on the home screen to play any game this way.
eloExplain: PixElo: how good you are – rated on the first solve of a puzzle per difficulty, against its par time. 1000 to start; “?” = still provisional.
pointsExplain: Points: everything you have solved, each puzzle counted once with its best medal (platinum counts most).
wrongAsk: Show your mistakes? This puzzle then only gives a bronze medal (and counts like Easy for PixElo).
parHelp: Par: the time a 1000 PixElo player needs. Faster raises your PixElo and gives a speed bonus.
updateTap: Tap to update now (your progress stays)
packsHelp: Add games, update them, the server
unlockHint: Solve {n} puzzles to open this one
extraHint: Finish every level in under 60 minutes each to unlock
confirmReset: Start this game from scratch? Your times and medals for it will be gone.
rulesEasy: Easy rules: mistakes are caught and cost no time. Earns bronze.
rulesNormal: Normal rules: mistakes are caught but cost time (2, 4, then 8 minutes). Earns silver.
rulesHard: Hard rules: no hint roulette, no safety net. Earns gold, or platinum without logic hints.
quitAsk: Quit and throw this board away?
overLimit: Over 60 minutes: the picture stays hidden this time.
serverHelp: A MomoGram server of your own keeps progress, the paused puzzle and settings the same on all your devices, and keeps packs for everyone with an account there. The files to put on your web space are in the "server" folder of MomoGram.
mergeAsk: The account already has the profile "{remote}". Combine it with "{local}" on this device?
err.notmomogram: There is no MomoGram server at that address.
err.password: The password needs at least 6 characters.
err.name: Please enter a name.
err.closed: This server has no invite code yet, so accounts can't be created (see config.php).
err.slow: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.full: This server already has its 10 players.
err.owner: Someone else made this pack, so only they can replace it on the server. Your changes stay on this device.
loggedOutMsg: The server logged "{name}" out (e.g. after a new password). Please log in again.
passwordSet: {name} has a new password and is logged out everywhere.
noScores: Nobody has solved a puzzle yet.
downloadBroken: A file arrived damaged, please try again.
serverEmpty: No packs on the server yet.
serverLogin: Log in under Options → Server to share packs between your devices.
musicNote: Packs keep the music of the game they came from. It stays on this device and in your own exports, so please don't share packs that contain music.
controls: Tap or drag to fill, the tool button switches to crossing out (right-click works too). Pinch, Ctrl + wheel or the zoom button zooms; drag the clues to move around. Keyboard and gamepad: arrows, A/Z fill, B/X cross out, Y/C zoom, Start menu.
saveWaiting: progress for {n} game(s) not added on this device is kept safe for later
notASave: That isn't a MomoGram save file.
saveHelp: Saves belong to the active profile. Importing your own save from another device only takes over the games you played there more recently.
saveNewProfile: Welcome, {name}! The profile was added and is now active.
saveMerged: {name}: {a} game(s) updated from the save, {b} kept because they're newer here.
edHelp: Draw your own puzzles or turn a picture into one. MomoGram checks that each has exactly one solution and suggests the smallest fix when it doesn't.
edNoPacks: No packs of your own yet.
edEmpty: Paint some cells or import a picture.
edAmbiguous: Several solutions: {n} cells can't be worked out
edFixFound: Changing {n} highlighted cell(s) gives exactly one solution.
edNoFix: No small fix found: try simplifying the picture.
edExportHelp: Your packs show up in your library and can be exported under Puzzle packs like any other.
soundTestOff: Music is switched off (or the games' own music): switch it on above to hear the songs.
soundTestNone: None of your games has music yet.
multiSolution: More than one picture fits these clues. Any of them solves the puzzle, but on Easy and Normal each cell is checked against the game's own picture.
galleryHelp: A few puzzles of every game: the board half solved in the game's look, and the solved picture. Tap a picture to zoom.
zoomHold: Zoom (tap); hold and move to look around
unratedReplay: Unrated replay (PixElo counts the first solve per rule set)
upToDate: already read with this version, nothing new
noNewData: no new data, kept as it is
soundTestHelp2: Tap a song to play it. The buttons set where the games play it; a role can have several songs, and a song that several games have changes in all of them. Changes go to the server with the next upload.
megaFromGameHelp: These mega numbers are the original ones of the game.
megaByMomoHelp: The game has no Mega version of this puzzle: MomoGram chose the mega numbers (the same for everyone) and checked that there is only one solution.
logicHardAsk: With logic hints, this puzzle can only earn gold, not platinum, even if you switch them off again. Switch them on?
megaHelp: Mega mode: every puzzle with mega numbers. A mega number spans two rows or columns and counts one connected group of cells that reaches into both. Puzzles of games without Mega puzzles get mega numbers chosen by MomoGram, the same for every player.
soundTestHelp: Tap a song to play it. The buttons beside it set where the game plays it; changes are saved in the pack and sent to the server with its next upload.
createHelp: Pick game files you own (Game Boy, Super Famicom, DS, DSiWare, decrypted 3DS; loose, zipped, 7z or rar). Switch games are folders: pick the decrypted RomFS folder with "Add a game folder", or add a zip of it. MomoGram reads the puzzles once and turns every game into a pack: keep the pack files and you never need the games again. Packs (.momopack, or older .json and .zip files) go through the same button.
noPacks: No games yet. Add one and the fun begins.
encrypted: encrypted 3DS file, please use a decrypted copy
practiceHelp: Little games with random puzzles from your games, in the mode that is on (Normal, Mega or Color). They don't count as solved: no medals, points or PixElo, only your best result is kept.
p_errorsHelp: A finished picture with a few wrong cells. Tap them, fast: a wrong tap costs 10 s.
p_finishHelp: Most of the puzzle is solved already. Do the rest as fast as you can.
p_sprintHelp: As many small puzzles as you can in one minute. A mistake costs 5 s.
p_spotHelp: A puzzle halfway through: find a cell you can be sure of now, and fill it or cross it out.
p_spotTask: Find a cell that is certain now: fill it or cross it out.
pNoPuzzles: Your games have no puzzles that fit this game yet.
updateAsk: A newer version of {name} is on the server. Update it now?
p_lineHelp: One row or column is marked: find every cell its own numbers decide now.
p_lineTask: Find the {n} cells this line decides now.
p_memoryHelp: You see the picture for 3 seconds, then solve it from memory (and the numbers).
